title: User authorization
discardDescription: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
noAccess: You do not have access to this section.
mobileHint: Mobile visibility follows the selected direct permissions.
saveFailed: Could not save changes. Your draft is still here.
forbidden: Your authorization changed. This section is frozen until you read it again.
verifyRequired: The save result is not confirmed. Read this section again before saving.
rereadHint: Reading again replaces only this section's draft with the latest server state.
busyMessage: Wait until saving and verification finish before leaving.
